description: Permissions for Downpour's windows. Every panel needs these, not just the main window: each one is a second webview driven by the same event stream, and omitting a label here silently blocks `listen`. A panel that cannot listen renders its first frame and then never changes again, which is the most confusing symptom available -- so a new window label belongs in this list as part of adding the window. `download-*` is the per-download box: one window per download, so it can only be matched by pattern.
